name: The Amber Birdcage

source.note: Cursed Curio from the Fields of the Crow; the book's numbers, our words.

magic.curse: While attuned, the cage is your chest: -1 to Wisdom saves, and 1 more for each fiend you catch or eat.

powers.name: Sense Fiends
powers.text: Learn where every Fiend within 60 ft is.

powers.name: Capture Fiend
powers.text: A Bloodied Fiend within 30 ft makes a DC 15 Charisma save or becomes an amber songbird in the cage.

powers.name: Eat a songbird
powers.text: The fiend dies for good; regain a spell slot of up to half its CR, or Temporary Hit Points equal to its CR.

summary: Raum's chest cage of amber and iron; while attuned it takes the place of your ribs. Sense fiends within 60 ft, catch a Bloodied one as a songbird, or eat a songbird for a spell slot. Cursed: each catch and each meal costs you more of your will (Wisdom saves).
